name: Nava de la Asunción (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, yellow above and below and green at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nava de la Asunción (a tower, a cross and pines within a bordure of saltires).
history: The arms and flag of Nava de la Asunción were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 1 June 1994; the flag is of proportion 2:3, quartered per saltire, green and yellow, with the arms at the centre.

features.role: division per saltire, green at the hoist and the fly
